{{Quote|I don't mean to brag; I just happen to be amazing.|Jyn Odan|<ref name="Star Wars: Imperial Assault Core Set">{{SWIA|set=Star Wars: Imperial Assault Core Set|text=Core Set}}</ref>}}
'''Jyn Odan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who worked for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She had built a solid reputation as a smuggler and [[Gunslinger/Legends|gunslinger]]. She was skilled at the [[Fast draw|quick draw]] and very agile.
